steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Income statement: revenue, COGS, gross profit, expenses, operating profit, profit for year

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Balance sheet: non-current assets, current assets, current liabilities, non-current liabilities, equity

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Cash flow: operating, investing, financing; free cash flow

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Ratios: Gross/Net margin, ROCE, Current/Acid test, Inventory/Payables/Receivables days, Gearing (debt/equity)

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: FC=GBP 50,000, VC=GBP 5/unit, P=GBP 15. Find break-even, margin of safety at 12,000 units, units for GBP 30,000 profit --- Solution: Contribution = 15-5=10. BE = 50,000/10 = 5,000 units. MoS = 12,000 - 5,000 = 7,000 units (58%). Target: (50,000+30,000)/10 = 8,000 units

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Calculate gross/net margin from income statement | Interpret current ratio 1.5 vs 0.8 | NPV: GBP 100k initial, GBP 30k/yr 5yrs, 10% discount

steps.title: Lesson plan
steps.body: Starter (5 min): Recall prior knowledge of finance and accounts with quick questions. Teaching (15 min): Work through each of the learning objectives, explaining principles step by step. Key points review (5 min): Revisit the key points together, confirming understanding. Worked example (10 min): Model the example question: FC=GBP 50,000, VC=GBP 5/unit, P=GBP 15. Find break-even, margin of safety at 12,000 units, units for GBP 30,000 profit. Solution: Contribution = 15-5=10. BE = 50,000/10 = 5,000 units. MoS = 12,000 - 5,000 = 7,000 units (58%). Target: (50,000+30,000)/10 = 8,000 units Practice (10 min): Students attempt the practice questions independently; circulate and support. Plenary (5 min): Review answers and address misconceptions.
